question: What measure and locus must be assigned to the wheel of the goddess for the support named here to hold in this instruction?
premises: The wheel is placed above in relation to the named support.
A support of four finger-breadths is specified for that locus.
The address marks the instruction as directed to the goddess.
inference: The wheel is located above a support measuring four finger-breadths addressed to the goddess.
uncertainties: Exact anatomical locus of the wheel remains undetermined from this verse alone.
plain_english: O lady of gods, above the goddess's wheel is a support of four finger-breadths.
